title: "04_descriptive_stats"
format: html

## Library loading
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

## Load data
```{r}
inner_df <- read_tsv(file = here("data/03_dat_aug_inner.tsv"))
left_df <- read_tsv(file = here("data/03_dat_aug_left.tsv"))
```

## Coverage
```{r}
# Simple description of the data found
left_df |>
  summarise(countries = n_distinct(country_code),
            first_year = min(year),
            last_year = max(year),
            n_mortality = sum(!is.na(mortality_rate)),
            n_measles = sum(!is.na(measles_coverage)),
            n_stunting = sum(!is.na(stunting_prevalence)))
```
## Medians by region in latest decade
```{r}
left_df |>
  filter(year >= 2020, year <= 2026) |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(median_mortality = median(mortality_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_measles = median(measles_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_stunting = median(stunting_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Visualize data by decades
```{r}
# Group by decades
left_df <- left_df |>
  mutate(decade = year %/% 10 * 10)

# Data for ridgeline
ridge_data <- left_df |>
  filter(year == decade, decade >= 1960) |>
  drop_na(mortality_rate) |>
  mutate(decade = as_factor(decade))

# Ridgeline plot for under-5 mortality per region
ridge_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mortality_rate, 
             y = fct_rev(decade), 
             fill = decade)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 1.5, 
                      alpha = 0.8, 
                      quantile_lines = TRUE, 
                      quantiles = 2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ region) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of under-5 mortality by decade and WHO region",
       x = "Under-5 mortality (deaths per 1,000 live births, log scale)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_ridges() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 9))

```
